kernel-org.description: kernel.org publishes its release index in the shape Renovate's custom datasource expects: {"releases": [{"version": ...}]}

customManagers.description: Update Buildroot version in the Makefile

Update the pinned Linux kernel in the Buildroot defconfig. NOTE: sb_enema/patches/linux/linux.hash must be updated in the same PR. With BR2_DOWNLOAD_FORCE_CHECK_HASHES=y set in the defconfig the build fails closed with 'ERROR: No hash found' until it is — do not merge a kernel bump that removes that option.

packageRules.description: Track the Buildroot 2026.05 series; moving to a new series is a deliberate, manually-validated change
Track 6.18.x longterm point releases only; moving off the 6.18 LTS series is a deliberate change
Track the secureboot_objects submodule by plain vX.Y.Z tags only (not branch commits), ignoring the -signed variant
